title: Sell on WhatsApp
intro: All your customer chats, from WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and your shop, come into one place: Chats.

steps.caption: Open a chat
steps.vo: Open Chats and tap a customer to read the conversation.

steps.caption: Peggy answers for you
steps.vo: Peggy, your AI assistant, can answer customers for you. She uses your own products, prices and delivery fees.

steps.caption: Reply, note, later or done
steps.vo: Type a reply, or add a private note that only your team sees. Tap Later to come back to it, or Done when it's finished.

steps.caption: Ask Peggy
steps.vo: Tap Ask Peggy to get help with your shop.

steps.caption: Ask her anything
steps.vo: Ask her things like, which orders do I need to send? She checks your orders, stock and sales for you.

outro: Answer fast, and you'll sell more.
